fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Obsidian Canvas
palette.role: Page background, card surfaces, inverted text on pink fills

palette.name: Parchment
palette.role: Primary body and heading text — warm near-white with sepia undertone, replaces the typical cool white of dark UIs

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Secondary text, button borders, metadata — mid-tone warm gray

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted body text, subtle link borders, inactive labels

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Hairline dividers, low-emphasis borders, heading underlines on dark

palette.name: Neon Petal
palette.role: Primary action buttons, active nav states, selected markers, occasional heading accents — the single chromatic punctuation in the system

palette.name: Acid Lime
palette.role: Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color
